distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records Hainan and Yunnan. Smith et al. (2020) independently confirms Hainan and Yunnan.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) species/genus-level hosts are retained. Smith et al. (2020) independently reports Castanopsis, Lithocarpus and Quercus at genus level. The unresolved Chinese-only host 红羽木 remains source-level evidence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion perpilosellum (Schedl, 1935).

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) uses Xyleborus punctatopilosum. Current canonical identity is Cyclorhipidion perpilosellum (Schedl, 1935), following integrated taxonomic backbone and Smith et al. (2020).
